fusions.name: Hobnailed Boot
fusions.desc: A kick with a hobnailed boot that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 5% easier to wound for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Column Advance
fusions.desc: Drives an armoured stamp forward, dealing 32 damage to every enemy in a cone 4 tiles ahead of you, ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Marching Plate
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 25% for 12 seconds and your movement speed by 15% for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Cobbled Bulwark
fusions.desc: On paved ground, your armour rises by 12%.
